name: segueit-projects
description: SegueIT Projects - enterprise project tracking platform (NestJS API + Next.js web)

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && npm run db:setup
scripts.predev: npm run env && npm run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @segueit/api" "npm run dev -w @segueit/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @segueit/api && npm run build -w @segueit/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:prod -w @segueit/api" "npm run start -w @segueit/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @segueit/api && npm run lint -w @segueit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @segueit/api && npm run typecheck -w @segueit/web
